# .claude_profile - Minimal shell configuration for Claude Code
# Place this in your home directory: ~/.claude_profile

[[ ! -f $HOME/.local/shell/.p10k.zsh ]] || source $HOME/.local/shell/.p10k.zsh

export PYTHON="/usr/bin/python3"
export OPENSSL="/usr/local/opt/openssl/bin"
export OPENSSH="/usr/local/bin/ssh:/usr/local/bin/ssh-add:/usr/local/bin/ssh-agent:/usr/local/bin/ssh-keygen:/usr/local/bin/ssh-keyscan:/usr/local/bin/sshfs"
export CURL="/usr/local/opt/curl/bin"
export GOPATH="$HOME/go"
export RUSTBIN="$HOME/.cargo/bin"
export PACTPATH="$HOME/.local/pact/bin"
export KREW_ROOT="$HOME/.krew"

export M2_HOME="$HOME/.m2"

export PATH="$CURL:$PATH:$PYTHON:$OPENSSL:$OPENSSH:$GOPATH/bin:$RUSTBIN"
export PATH="$PATH:$JAVA_HOME:$PACTPATH"
export PATH="$PATH:/Users/rambhiad/.local/bin"
export PATH="$PATH:$KREW_ROOT/bin"
export PATH="$PATH:$CODEQL_CLI"
export PATH="$PATH:$M2_HOME/bin"

# Python version manager (pyenv) - from your config
if command -v pyenv >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    export PYENV_ROOT="$HOME/.pyenv"
    export PATH="$PYENV_ROOT/bin:$PATH"
    eval "$(pyenv init -)"
fi

# SDKMAN - from your config
export SDKMAN_DIR="$HOME/.sdkman"

# AWS CLI completion - from your config

# Certificate bundle from your config

alias ga='git add'

alias gp='git push'
alias gl='git pull'

# Directory navigation helpers (without zoxide)

alias ...='cd ../..'
alias ....='cd ../../..'

# Utility functions

}

    source _awsd

fi

# Function to setup certificates
setup-certs() {
  local cert_path="/Users/rambhiad/.certs/all.pem"
  local cert_dir="$(dirname "${cert_path}")"
  if [[ ! -s "$cert_path" ]]; then
        [[ -d "${cert_dir}" ]] || mkdir -p "${cert_dir}" && chown rambhiad "${cert_dir}"
        security find-certificate -a -p /System/Library/Keychains/SystemRootCertificates.keychain > "${cert_path}"
        security find-certificate -a -p /Library/Keychains/System.keychain >> "${cert_path}"
  fi
  export GIT_SSL_CAINFO="${cert_path}" 
  export AWS_CA_BUNDLE="${cert_path}"
  export NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS="${cert_path}"
  npm config set -g cafile "${cert_path}" --quiet
  npm config set -g strict-ssl true --quiet
  if command -v yarn >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        yarn --silent config set cafile "${cert_path}" -g
        yarn --silent config set strict-ssl true -g
  fi        
}
